title: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: A traditional Italian pizza with fresh tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil
steps: Preheat oven to 500°F (260°C)
Roll out the pizza dough on a floured surface
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the dough
Tear mozzarella into small pieces and distribute over sauce
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper
Bake for 10-12 minutes until crust is golden
Remove from oven and top with fresh basil leaves
Slice and serve immediately

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Soft and chewy homemade chocolate chip cookies that are perfect for any occasion
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C)
Mix flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl
Beat butter and both sugars until creamy
Add eggs one at a time, then vanilla
Gradually beat in flour mixture
Stir in chocolate chips
Drop rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheets
Bake 9-11 minutes until golden brown
Cool on baking sheet for 2 minutes before removing

title: Grilled Salmon with Lemon Herbs
description: Perfectly grilled salmon fillets with a refreshing lemon and herb marinade
steps: Preheat grill to medium-high heat
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, herbs, and lemon zest
Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper
Brush marinade over both sides of salmon
Grill salmon for 4-5 minutes per side
Cook until fish flakes easily with a fork
Remove from grill and let rest for 2 minutes
Serve with additional lemon wedges

title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Rich and creamy Italian risotto with mixed mushrooms and parmesan cheese
steps: Heat broth in a saucepan and keep warm
Heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large pan
Sauté onions until translucent, add garlic
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes until lightly toasted
Add wine and stir until absorbed
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly
Sauté mushrooms separately in remaining butter
When rice is al dente, stir in mushrooms and parmesan
Season with salt and pepper, serve immediately

title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
description: A healthy and delicious breakfast featuring creamy avocado on toast with a perfectly poached egg
steps: Bring water to a gentle boil in a deep pan
Add vinegar to the water
Toast the bread slices until golden
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper
Crack eggs into separate small bowls
Create a whirlpool in the boiling water
Drop eggs into the center and cook for 3-4 minutes
Spread mashed avocado on toast
Top with poached eggs and red pepper flakes
Drizzle with olive oil and serve

title: Beef Stir Fry with Vegetables
description: Quick and flavorful beef stir fry with crisp vegetables in a savory sauce
steps: Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and cornstarch in a bowl
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large wok or skillet
Stir-fry beef for 2-3 minutes until browned
Remove beef and set aside
Add remaining oil and stir-fry vegetables
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute
Return beef to the pan
Pour sauce mixture over everything
Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve

title: Caesar Salad with Homemade Dressing
description: Classic Caesar salad with crisp romaine lettuce and creamy homemade dressing
steps: Make dressing: blend anchovies, garlic, and lemon juice
Add dijon mustard and Worcestershire sauce
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while blending
Season with salt and pepper
Wash and dry lettuce thoroughly
Toss lettuce with dressing until well coated
Add croutons and parmesan cheese
Toss gently and serve immediately

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Decadent chocolate lava cake with a molten chocolate center, perfect for dessert
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C)
Grease 4 ramekins with butter
Melt chocolate and butter in a double boiler
Beat eggs, yolks, and sugar until pale and thick
Fold in melted chocolate mixture
Add flour and vanilla extract
Pour batter into prepared ramekins
Bake for 12-14 minutes until edges are set
Let cool for 1 minute, then invert onto plates
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with ice cream

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Creamy and aromatic Indian curry with tender chicken pieces in a rich tomato-based sauce
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garlic, ginger, and half the garam masala for 30 minutes
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Cook marinated chicken until golden brown
Remove chicken and set aside
Sauté onions until translucent
Add remaining garam masala and cook for 1 minute
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes
Return chicken to the pan
Stir in heavy cream and simmer for 5 minutes
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve over basmati rice

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowl
description: Healthy and colorful quinoa bowl loaded with fresh vegetables, olives, and feta cheese
steps: Cook quinoa in vegetable broth according to package directions
Let quinoa cool to room temperature
In a large bowl, combine cooled quinoa with cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion
Add olives and feta cheese
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano
Pour dressing over quinoa mixture and toss gently
Season with salt and pepper
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving
Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: Beef Wellington
description: Elegant beef tenderloin wrapped in puff pastry with mushroom duxelles
steps: Season beef tenderloin with salt and pepper
Sear beef in hot oil on all sides until browned
Brush with Dijon mustard and let cool
Sauté mushrooms, shallots, and garlic in butter
Cook until liquid evaporates, season with salt and pepper
Roll out puff pastry on floured surface
Layer prosciutto on pastry, then mushroom mixture
Place beef in center and wrap tightly
Seal edges and brush with egg wash
Bake at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until golden

title: Lemon Blueberry Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes bursting with fresh blueberries and bright lemon flavor
steps: Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt
In separate bowl, beat eggs with buttermilk
Add melted butter, vanilla, and lemon zest
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients
Stir until just combined, don't overmix
Gently fold in blueberries
Heat griddle or pan over medium heat
Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake
Cook until bubbles form on surface
Flip and cook until golden brown
Serve with maple syrup

title: Thai Green Curry
description: Aromatic Thai curry with coconut milk, fresh vegetables, and your choice of protein
steps: Heat half the coconut milk in a large pot
Add curry paste and cook for 2 minutes
Add remaining coconut milk and bring to a simmer
Add chicken and cook for 5 minutes
Add vegetables and cook for 8-10 minutes
Stir in fish sauce and brown sugar
Add basil and lime leaves
Simmer for 2 more minutes
Remove lime leaves before serving
Serve over jasmine rice

title: Caprese Stuffed Chicken
description: Juicy chicken breast stuffed with fresh mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F
Cut a pocket in each chicken breast
Season inside and outside with salt and pepper
Stuff each breast with mozzarella, tomato, and basil
Secure with toothpicks if needed
Heat olive oil in oven-safe skillet
Sear chicken for 3-4 minutes per side
Transfer to oven and bake for 15-20 minutes
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving
Drizzle with balsamic glaze

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
description: Moist and tender banana bread loaded with chocolate chips and warm spices
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F
Grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan
Mash bananas in a large bowl
Mix in melted butter and brown sugar
Beat in egg and vanilla extract
Add baking soda and salt
Stir in flour and cinnamon
Fold in chocolate chips
Pour batter into prepared pan
Bake for 50-60 minutes until toothpick comes out clean
Cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing

title: Shrimp Scampi Pasta
description: Classic Italian pasta with succulent shrimp in a garlic white wine sauce
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions
Heat olive oil in a large skillet
Season shrimp with salt and pepper
Sauté shrimp for 2-3 minutes until pink
Remove shrimp and set aside
Add garlic to the same pan
Cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add white wine and bring to a simmer
Add butter and stir until melted
Return shrimp to pan with pasta
Toss with parsley and lemon juice
Serve immediately

title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
description: Healthy and delicious layered parfait with Greek yogurt, berries, and granola
steps: Mix honey and vanilla into Greek yogurt
Layer yogurt in serving glasses
Add a layer of mixed berries
Sprinkle with granola
Repeat layers until glasses are full
Top with fresh mint leaves
Add chopped nuts if desired
Chill for 30 minutes before serving
Serve cold

title: Beef Bulgogi
description: Korean marinated beef that's sweet, savory, and incredibly tender
steps: Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger
Add grated pear to the marinade
Marinate beef for at least 2 hours or overnight
Heat a large skillet or grill pan
Cook marinated beef in batches
Cook for 2-3 minutes per side
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds
Serve immediately over white rice

title: Ratatouille
description: Classic French vegetable stew with eggplant, zucchini, and tomatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F
Toss vegetables with olive oil and seasonings
Spread vegetables on baking sheets
Roast for 20-25 minutes until tender
Sauté onions and garlic in large pot
Add roasted vegetables and crushed tomatoes
Simmer for 15-20 minutes
Season with fresh herbs
Serve warm or at room temperature

title: Tiramisu
description: Classic Italian dessert with layers of coffee-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cream
steps: Beat egg yolks and sugar until thick and pale
Heat milk in saucepan until steaming
Temper egg mixture with hot milk
Cook over low heat until thickened
Cool mixture completely
Beat mascarpone until smooth
Fold mascarpone into egg mixture
Whip heavy cream with vanilla
Fold whipped cream into mascarpone mixture
Mix coffee with liqueur
Dip ladyfingers in coffee mixture
Layer ladyfingers and cream mixture
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours
Dust with cocoa powder before serving
